name: phil-tools
description: Syntax highlighting, Grammar-v1 syntax checking with error codes, outline, hovers, snippets and formatting for the Phil systems language.

commands.title: Phil: Emit LLVM IR with philc

enumDescriptions: Grammar v1, falling back to legacy Phase 0 checks for files with no `;` terminators
Always check as canonical Grammar v1
Always treat as legacy Phase 0 syntax (lexical and bracket checks only)
phil.syntax.description: Which Phil surface syntax to check against.

phil.diagnostics.enable.description: Check Phil files for Grammar-v1 syntax errors as you type.

phil.diagnostics.maxErrors.description: Maximum number of syntax errors reported per file.

phil.philc.path.description: Path to the philc compiler (used by 'Phil: Emit LLVM IR with philc').

phil.philc.target.description: Target triple passed to philc emit-llvm.

scripts.build: esbuild src/extension.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:vscode --outfile=out/extension.js --log-level=warning && esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=out/cli.js --log-level=warning && esbuild src/mcp.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=out/mcp.js --log-level=warning && node scripts/build-playground.js
scripts.gen: python3 scripts/gen-grammar.py && esbuild scripts/gen-docs.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=out/gen-docs.js --log-level=error && node out/gen-docs.js
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:sim && npm run test:designer && npm run test:playground && npm run test:smoke
scripts.test:corpus: esbuild test/test.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=out/test.js --log-level=error && cp node_modules/vscode-oniguruma/release/onig.wasm out/ && node out/test.js
